tools.name: sms_validate_number
tools.description:
Use this when you need to check if a phone number can receive SMS messages. Returns SMS capability data in JSON.

Returns: 1. canReceiveSMS (boolean) 2. carrierType (mobile/landline/voip) 3. e164 formatted number 4. countryCode 5. numberType (mobile/landline/voip/toll-free) 6. carrier name.

Example

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sms_validate_number · Public sink: sms_validate_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sms_validate_number · Public sink: sms_validate_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
